1.content:
| Item | Description |
|---|---|
| Scope of Work | Bristlecone shall provide the Services described in this SOW in accordance with the governing MSA. |
| Scope Description | The Services cover implementation of SAP Cloud ALM for Metro to support Technical Monitoring and Change Request Management in alignment with Metro’s S/4 RISE migration plan from January 2026 through October 2026. In scope are SAP Cloud ALM tenant setup and user management; SAP Cloud ALM Standard Change Management; ChaRM workflow configuration; transport routes and release strategy configuration across DEV, QA, and PROD; end-to-end Dev and QA change cycle testing; production system mapping in the ChaRM workflow; SAP landscape and data-flow configuration to Cloud ALM; monitoring setup for SAP S/4HANA Cloud, BTP applications, MII, Datasphere, Ariba, and SAP Integration Suite; system health, application, job, user performance, and integration monitoring; alert and notification configuration; standard health monitoring and change management dashboards; train-the-trainer support; SOP updates for end users; issue resolution during deployment; and transition and hypercare support through October 2026. Services are provided on a Time & Materials basis against actual approved effort, subject to the not-to-exceed ceiling stated elsewhere in this SOW. |

1.3.content:
- SAP Cloud ALM subscription will be active and available by January 2026.
- Metro will complete technical team onboarding between February 2026 and April 2026.
- Metro will identify the in-scope landscape for SAP S/4HANA Cloud, BTP applications, MII, Datasphere, Ariba, and SAP Integration Suite before configuration starts.
- Metro will confirm the integration technologies used for monitored interfaces, including CPI and SAP Integration Suite, before monitoring design is finalized.
- Metro will provide the Cloud ALM user and role matrix in time for authorization setup and testing.
- Metro will finalize monitoring use cases and metric values by May 2026.
- Metro will provide the target transport governance model needed for ChaRM configuration and transport sequence setup.
- Metro’s core project team will participate in ChaRM cycle testing, issue review, and transition activities when scheduled.
- Successful go-live of all required landscapes will occur before production deployment and hypercare activities begin.
- If any assumption does not hold, the Change Request process in section 5 applies and the cost and timeline may be revised.

1.4.content:
- Business Process Monitoring and Intelligent Event Processing are not included.
- SAP Cloud ALM capabilities identified as Cloud ALM++ planned capabilities are not included.
- No custom development, enhancement, or remediation outside standard SAP Cloud ALM configuration will be provided.
- No support is included for systems not named in scope, including any non-SAP applications except the identified integrations with SAP Integration Suite.
- No production support beyond the October 2026 hypercare and transition period will be provided.
- No client-side infrastructure administration, endpoint management, or network remediation will be provided.
- No migration of historical Solution Manager content, custom schemas, PPFs, or legacy monitoring artifacts is included unless expressly stated elsewhere in scope.
- No user execution of Metro-owned cutover, transport migration, or operational run-book tasks will be performed by Bristlecone except for advisory and transition support stated in scope.
- Anything not expressly stated as in scope is excluded and requires a change request.

2.1.content:
Services will be delivered on a Time & Materials basis during the standard business hours of the assigned delivery location, Monday through Friday, excluding public holidays observed at that location. For offshore resources, the applicable holiday calendar will be the Bristlecone delivery-center holiday calendar for <CONFIRM: named offshore delivery location>; for onsite resources, the applicable holiday calendar will be Metro’s local holiday calendar at the approved client site.

Work requested outside standard business hours, on weekends, or on applicable holidays requires prior written approval from Metro’s authorized project manager or designated lead. Approved after-hours work will be billed monthly in arrears based on actual effort expended at the agreed role rates, with any shift allowance or premium charging applied only if expressly set out in the Commercials section and approved in advance.

2.2.content:
Service Location: Hybrid.

Delivery will be performed through a hybrid model combining Bristlecone offshore delivery with Metro stakeholder engagement and project governance at the client location. Offshore execution will cover configuration, testing support, documentation, monitoring setup, dashboard configuration, and transition support. Onsite participation will be limited to workshops, governance meetings, critical design discussions, testing coordination, go-live planning, and hypercare coordination as requested.

The expected delivery split is approximately 80% Offshore and 20% Onsite. Named locations: Offshore — Bristlecone delivery center in <CONFIRM: city/country>; Onsite — Metro location(s) designated for the SAP CLOUD ALM program.

3.content:
Deliverables will be reviewed against the measurable acceptance criteria set out below. Review and acceptance are for quality assurance only and do not control invoicing, which remains on a Time & Materials basis against actual effort expended, client-approved timesheets, and the not-to-exceed ceiling.

| Deliverable | Measurable Acceptance Criteria | Reviewer | Review Window |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cloud ALM value proposition and scope document | Document submitted in editable or PDF format; scope covers Technical Monitoring and Change Request Management; in-scope systems and use cases identified; no open section marked "TBD" or equivalent for agreed scope items | Metro Project Governance Team / Metro Single POC | 5 business days |
| Connectivity plan for use cases | Plan identifies source systems, target SAP Cloud ALM tenant/subaccount, required connections, and data flow path for agreed use cases; prerequisites, dependencies, and responsible parties documented | Metro Project Governance Team / Metro technical lead | 5 business days |
| Cloud ALM onboarding documentation | Documentation covers tenant onboarding steps, user/role setup prerequisites, landscape identification inputs, and access dependencies; document is complete and usable by Metro project team without Bristlecone verbal clarification | Metro Project Governance Team / Metro technical lead | 5 business days |
| Landscape readiness with prerequisite note implementation and configuration | Required prerequisite configurations completed for agreed in-scope landscapes; readiness evidence provided through configuration record, checklist, or walkthrough; no Severity 1 or Severity 2 open issue blocking planned build activities | Metro technical lead / Metro Project Governance Team | 5 business days |
| Data flow between SAP systems to CALM | Agreed data flow is configured and demonstrated for in-scope systems; monitoring or integration data is received in SAP Cloud ALM for the applicable use case; any failed interface or missing feed is logged for correction | Metro technical lead | 5 business days |
| Mapping of transport sequence (DEV → QA → PROD) | Transport route and release strategy design documented; DEV, QA, and PROD sequence mapped for agreed change process; workflow aligns to the approved target transport governance model | Metro Single POC for ChaRM Input / Metro Core Team for ChaRM Cycle Testing | 5 business days |
| Configured Change Management workflow | SAP Cloud ALM standard change workflow configured for agreed change types, statuses, approvals, and release steps; workflow demonstrated in system; configuration supports the agreed ChaRM process for in-scope landscapes | Metro Single POC for ChaRM Input / Metro Core Team for ChaRM Cycle Testing | 7 business days |
| Transport routes and release strategies configured | Transport routes created for agreed systems; release strategy configured and demonstrated; at least one end-to-end walkthrough shows route behavior matches the approved sequence and governance model | Metro Core Team for ChaRM Cycle Testing | 7 business days |
| First wave of change cycle tested end-to-end for Dev and QA | End-to-end test executed for agreed first-wave change cycle across Dev and QA; expected status transitions, approvals, transport movement, and traceability completed; test results recorded and shared | Metro Core Team for ChaRM Cycle Testing | 7 business days |
| Health Monitoring | Health monitoring configured for agreed non-production and production in-scope systems; agreed metrics or thresholds loaded; alerts visible in SAP Cloud ALM dashboard for the configured scope | Metro technical lead / Metro operations lead | 7 business days |
| Job and Automation Monitoring | Monitoring configured for agreed jobs or automation objects; job status visibility demonstrated in SAP Cloud ALM; alerting or exception handling works for at least one test case | Metro technical lead / Metro operations lead | 7 business days |
| User Performance Monitoring | Monitoring configured for agreed S/4HANA user performance scope; relevant user performance data is visible in SAP Cloud ALM; dashboards or reports show measurable performance indicators | Metro technical lead / Metro operations lead | 7 business days |
| Integration and Exception Monitoring | Monitoring configured for agreed S/4 and Integration Suite interfaces; exception visibility demonstrated; alert or notification generated for at least one test condition | Metro technical lead / Metro operations lead | 7 business days |
| Alerting and notification setup | Alert rules, recipients, and notification paths configured for agreed use cases; at least one alert notification successfully generated and received through the agreed channel | Metro technical lead / Metro operations lead | 5 business days |
| Monitoring dashboard | Dashboard published in SAP Cloud ALM; agreed monitoring widgets or views are present; dashboard displays data for configured in-scope systems and use cases | Metro Project Governance Team / Metro operations lead | 5 business days |
| Train the trainer workshop | Workshop delivered for agreed Metro participants; training materials shared; attendance recorded; agenda covers agreed Cloud ALM monitoring and/or change management topics | Metro Project Governance Team | 5 business days |
| SOP for end users | SOP delivered in document form; steps reflect the configured process or monitoring workflow; document includes roles, inputs, key steps, and expected outcomes for the agreed user group | Metro Project Governance Team / Metro Single POC | 5 business days |
| Mapping of production system in ChaRM workflow | Production system mapped in configured ChaRM workflow; workflow routing and transport path demonstrated for production-relevant release process; mapping aligns to approved landscape design | Metro Single POC for ChaRM Input / Metro Core Team for ChaRM Cycle Testing | 5 business days |
| Add production system in monitoring use cases | Production system added to agreed monitoring use cases; monitoring data or status visibility demonstrated in SAP Cloud ALM; alerts and dashboards reflect production inclusion where applicable | Metro technical lead / Metro operations lead | 5 business days |
| Issue resolution | Logged configuration or deployment issues assigned during the applicable phase are resolved or moved to a mutually agreed action log with target owner and date; no unresolved Severity 1 defect blocks agreed go-live or transition activity | Metro Project Governance Team / relevant Metro lead | 5 business days |
| Document update | Agreed project documents updated to reflect delivered configuration, workflow, monitoring setup, or transition changes; latest version shared with Metro | Metro Project Governance Team | 3 business days |
| Support transition to Metro team | Transition session completed; agreed knowledge transfer materials provided; Metro support contacts identified; open items, known issues, and handoff responsibilities documented | Metro Project Governance Team / Metro operations lead | 5 business days |

Absent a written rejection that identifies the specific failed acceptance criterion within the applicable review window, the deliverable is deemed accepted automatically on expiry of that review window.

If Metro rejects a deliverable within the review window, Bristlecone will correct the stated non-conformities and re-submit the deliverable; Metro will then have 3 business days to review the re-submitted deliverable against the previously rejected criteria only.

5.content:
Any change to the scope, assumptions, deliverables, exclusions, timeline, staffing, delivery location, or commercials under this SOW shall be managed only through a written Change Request (“CR”) or written amendment signed by both parties. Each CR must describe the requested change, the reason for the change, and the resulting impact on scope, schedule, effort, dependencies, and the not-to-exceed ceiling.

Bristlecone shall document a mandatory impact assessment for every CR, including both commercial impact and timeline impact, even where the impact is zero. Impact assessment shall state the incremental or reduced effort, applicable role rates, any change to the not-to-exceed ceiling, any effect on milestone or go-live dates, and any dependency or assumption change.

Metro may initiate a CR through its Primary Client Contact, and Bristlecone may initiate a CR through its Primary Bristlecone Contact. Each proposed CR shall be reviewed by the Metro Project Governance Team and Bristlecone Project Management, with final approval authority held by Metro’s authorized signatory and Bristlecone’s authorized signatory unless the governing agreement delegates amendment authority differently. <LEGAL: confirm whether designated project leads may approve CRs below a stated value threshold, or whether all CRs require signatory approval>

No work related to a change may begin until the CR is approved and signed by both parties. Any work performed before approval is at Bristlecone’s risk, is not chargeable, and shall not justify extension of any agreed date, including the September 2026 go-live or the October 2026 hypercare transition end date, unless and until the signed CR expressly revises that date.

Approved CRs shall be incorporated into this SOW by amendment, addendum, or written CR record signed by both parties. Monthly invoicing shall continue on a Time & Materials basis against actual effort expended at agreed role rates and client-approved timesheets, and only approved changed work may be billed within the revised not-to-exceed ceiling. Deliverable acceptance governs completion quality and rework obligations only and does not trigger payment.
